lesson_1: Candidate construction packages report.json status should be set to 'completed' after merge/push, not left as 'candidate_ready_awaiting_manual_review'.
lesson_2: If validate-canonical-repair requires 'completed' status, a minimal evidence status completion candidate must be used to close the gap.
lesson_3: validate-canonical-repair failure (report_status_not_completed) must not be claimed as success or ignored.
lesson_4: R032 acceptance/chain-status update must only proceed after CI green (both validate-round and validate-canonical-repair passing).
lesson_5: PRE_R049 token must never be interpreted as R049 authorization.
recommended_process_change: After merge/push of a construction candidate, immediately update report.json status to 'completed' in the same merge commit, or create a follow-up candidate before the CI run completes.
